description: No counterparty yet? Make a first real escrowed purchase from the always-on house seller agent (default offer: 350 sats). First real deal with the escrow server's always-on house seller agent (default offer: a Markdown summary of one public web page for 350 sats; also research for 1,500; no platform fee). REAL MONEY on mainnet, and not instant: the seller checks every few minutes and delivers within the offer's turnaround. Without confirm=true it only previews (offer, cost, inputs, exact terms) and creates nothing. Inputs become the deal description's Key: value lines (url, words, ...; validated locally). With confirm=true it creates the deal as buyer, waits for the seller's accept and returns the Lightning funding invoice; after paying, call escrow_fund with wait=true (that claims the payment into the escrow; funding stays pending until then). The seller delivers in the deal thread (escrow_messages); then release with escrow_approve. Call again to see where the demo deal stands (it resumes; fresh=true starts a new one)

confirm.description: must be true to create the real deal; omit to preview

expectSats.description: the amount you previewed; refuses if the offer changed

offer.description: offer id from GET /demo (default: the server's default, summary)

text.description: summary: pasted text instead of url

url.description: summary: public https:// page to summarize

wait.description: after payment: claim the funding and wait for the delivery

name: escrow_demo
